purpose: Build a hash-anchored receipt proving a specific e-invoice's transmitted bytes were format-validated and VAT-arithmetic-checked, with the routed mandate attached. Binds to the as-transmitted document digest (and, for hybrid Factur-X, the embedded XML digest separately). Proves validation was run; never certifies tax compliance, legal validity, or clearance-platform acceptance. Terminal node of the einvoice-validation-pipeline chain. Zero network, zero PII.
